descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you want to design and build next generation business applications using the latest technologies? Are you confident at iteratively refining user requirements and removing any ambiguity? Do you like to be challenged and encouraged to learn and grow professionally?

We’re looking for a developer for the IT Crew “Obtain Pension Solutions” to:
• work closely with the Requirements Engineer, the Solution Architect as well as the Product Owner in the team and translate the requirements into tasks and stories for the development team
• be an active member of our development team (Backend & Frontend) and deliver software, enabling our business growth and strategy
• ensure highest quality delivery of our Software and implement respective quality measures and checks
• ensure the fully development cycle including proper documentation, unit testing and test automation scripting
• support the team in our Crew with your own development skills and ability
